test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

Why don’t / you throw this / paper on the dust bin?
solution:
The correct answer is '**paper on the dust bin**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**paper on the dust bin**" is incorrect.
 
• The correct preposition should be "**in**" instead of "**on**" when referring to placing something inside a container.
 
• Thus, the correct phrase should be "**paper in the dustbin**".
 
• Proper prepositions are crucial for clear and accurate communication.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.

Correct sentence: *Why don’t you throw this **paper in the dustbin**?*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: No error** - This option is incorrect as there is an error in the sentence.
 
• **Option 3: you throw this** - This part of the sentence is correct and does not contain any error.
 
• **Option 4: Why don’t** - This part of the sentence is also correct and does not contain any error.
